## What changed

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Safety boundary

- [ ] Exact scope and target validation remain backend-owned.
- [ ] Models still have no MCPwn, shell or operating-system command authority.
- [ ] Dangerous actions still require fresh, expiring human approval.
- [ ] Execution remains stoppable, time-limited, output-limited and audited.
- [ ] Report claims remain bound to verified evidence.
- [ ] No secrets, runtime data, evidence or private target information are included.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests.
- [ ] Ran `npm run verify` successfully.
- [ ] Documented any remaining limitation honestly.
